page.overview:
Who is Chris Watson?

is the main protagonist of He Told Me Everything, the third story of Fazbear Frights 7: The Cliffs. He is a snobby teenage boy who desperately wants to be rich and successful, which he hopes becoming part of his high school's Science Club will help him achieve.

Chris has short, neatly cut sandy-brown hair that he maintains with some gel. On the first day of school, he wears a polo shirt and khakis.

Chris is a science nerd who loves learning. He is also a snob who wants to be seen as prestigious and fantasizes about living a higher-status lifestyle. Chris is embarrassed by his parents as he believes they're unrefined, although he still wishes to give them a successful and rich life. He's also annoyed by his friends as he believes they lack maturity and ambition, leading to him abandoning them for higher-status friends. Chris always desires owning more elegant things and is disappointed by the cheaper things his family compromises with. Despite his desires to be independent, he recognizes his youth and begrudgingly follows his parents’ orders. Chris still gets rather squamish when it comes to dental matters and he cheats during the lock-in with an old baby tooth. When he finally realizes that the Faz-Goo is replacing him, he regrets his past behavior and tells the clone to be nicer than he was.

Chris is preparing for his first day of high school and makes sure to have a good first impression. He despises his family's low status and is eager to join the school's Science Club, known infamously in the town. He especially looks forward to the after-school experiment held by the teacher, Dr. Little, as it was a "life-changing" experiment that made the students popular in school.
